dreamteamer.title: Contacts
dreamteamer.description: People you deal with — `contacts`, each pointing at the `companies` record they work for, with an avatar from `assets`. With `meetings` installed, each contact also carries the latest meeting they attended. Filling a person in from LinkedIn is `@dreamteamer/connectors-linkedin`, installed separately.
